$meta.ruling: G3 裁决一.3 — [F-EMIT] direct-emitter bypass discipline (front-door emission-authority ratchet).
$meta.purpose: Authoritative allow-list of the repack gemm_tile cells whose body is emitted by a hand-written emitRepackGem{v,m}<fmt> DIRECT EMITTER that BYPASSES the L2 typed-region front door (RVVLowerQuantContraction.cpp lowerToRepackGemv/lowerToRepackGemm -> tcrv_rvv.typed_repack_gemv_loop_body / typed_repack_gemm_loop_body). A direct-emitter repack path is TRANSITIONAL SCAFFOLDING: it dispatch-wires a format (feeds C_dispatch, NEVER C_construct) while the terminal state ([K-3b]) is that the front door is the SOLE emission authority and every gemm_tile is CONSTRUCTED as a typed region (the q4_0 decode/prefill precedent). Every direct-emitter that is production-wired in the kBlockDotKernels dispatch table MUST be named here with a retirement_batch; an un-whitelisted bypass fails the [F-EMIT] gate closed. The list is a RATCHET DOWN: it only shrinks as tiles are retired to the front door.
constitution: A 'direct-emitter bypass' = a &VariantToEmitCFunc::emitRepackGem{v,m}<fmt> entry wired into the production dispatch table kBlockDotKernels (lib/Conversion/RVV/RVVToEmitC.cpp). Its recognizer matches a monolith repack op (tcrv_rvv.repack_gem{v,m}_<fmt>) and its emitter writes the whole repacked GEVM/GEMM body by hand -- it does NOT go through the typed_repack_gem{v,m}_loop_body region that the front door constructs. The typed-region path (isTypedRepackGemvLoopBody/isTypedRepackGemmLoopBody -> emitTypedRepackGem{v,m}LoopBody) is the FRONT DOOR and is NOT a bypass (q4_0 only, at this cut).

provenance = 'direct-emitter (transitional scaffolding)': the same string is stamped on the matching gemm_tile cell in schema/coverage-sixstate.v1.json. The bypass cell is dispatch-wired (feeds C_dispatch); reporting it as constructed is an [L-8] violation the [F-EMIT] gate rejects.

retirement_batch names the campaign that will retire the bypass into the front door, following the q4_0 typed_repack precedent (region-vs-monolith byte-exactness proven before the monolith emitter is retired): 0=flat-mainline (q4_1/q5_0/q5_1/q8_0 -- the readiest, the q4_0 typed_repack_gemv/gemm template already exists) ; 1=ternary (tq1_0/tq2_0) ; 2=iq4 codebook (iq4_nl/iq4_xs) ; 3=iq2 codebook (iq2_xxs/iq2_xs/iq2_s -- iq2_xs/iq2_s landed by the in-flight repack line #80-86, folded in at baseline 15->17) ; 4=fp4 codebook (mxfp4) ; 5=K-quant super-block (q2_K/q3_K/q4_K/q5_K/q6_K) via the mainline-A super-block repack front door.

shrink-only ratchet: baseline_count MUST EQUAL len(entries) (the [F-EMIT] gate fails closed on any drift), so a NEW bypass can never be added SILENTLY -- adding one forces a visible baseline_count bump in the same diff, which is the tamper-evident tripwire. baseline_count only ever DECREASES across git history (that monotone-down property is the shrink-only invariant, enforced by review of the diff). Adding a bypass is allowed only by retiring another OR by a sanctioned in-flight exception that predates G3 (e.g. the iq2_xs/iq2_s repack line, tasks #80-86) with the bump justified here. When a tile retires to the front door its emitter symbols leave kBlockDotKernels; the gate then flags the now-stale whitelist entry RED until it is MOVED to retired_ledger and baseline_count is decremented -- this is the mechanism that drives 旁路存量 -> 0.

The gate is fail-closed in BOTH directions: a production-wired emitRepackGem* absent from this list => RED (un-whitelisted bypass); a whitelist emitter symbol no longer wired in kBlockDotKernels => RED (stale -- the tile retired to the front door; MOVE it to retired_ledger).
